page.notes: Marginal notes are placed at their approximate positions; the Greek line "πληθυντικῶς" is a best reading, and "τειςπήλῳ" and "κείμϱιον" are uncertain. Catchword and signature not printed. The "CAP." line is the chapter mark at the foot of the text.
